verdict.rationale: Docs describe plan tiers (Premium $20/month for higher limits), ability to buy more credits, and note that starting from existing files costs no tokens — giving some visibility into pricing/credit mechanics. But there's no comprehensive breakdown of how many credits/tokens each action (chat message, generation, deploy, etc.) consumes, and community evidence shows a user actually being surprised by real usage costs (>$20/day) despite subscribing. Missing for 10: a full credit-consumption table/reference per action type, in-product usage dashboard evidence, and independent confirmation that founders can reliably predict spend.
